title: Outer Banks Explorer Helicopter Tour
blurb:
Discover the Outer Banks from a unique perspective on this exhilarating helicopter tour. Departing from Manteo, soar above breathtaking landscapes including Roanoke Sound, Jockey's Ridge dunes, and the historical Wright Brothers National Memorial. As you glide over pristine beaches and iconic lighthouses like Bodie Island, take in the stunning coastal scenery and learn about the region’s rich history through live narration. Perfect for all ages, this unforgettable flight promises an exceptional experience for families, photographers, and adventure seekers alike. 

- Enjoy a 25-minute aerial tour of the Outer Banks' most famous sights
- All window seats with live narration provided by knowledgeable pilots
- Suitable for all ages; minimum of 2 and maximum of 3 per flight group
- Depart from Manteo with beautiful views of the Atlantic Ocean and barrier islands
